# Lies or Liars

> Primary-source case files. Official records. No speculation.

Lies or Liars is an archive of case files built from primary documents: court records, police files, and other official papers. What the document says is what we report. This is not a podcast. It is not an opinion. It is an archive.

Citable file pages are at /files/{id}.html. The homepage at https://liesorliars.com/ lists the archive.

## Arcade

- [Arrest the Epstein List](https://liesorliars.com/arrest.html): Archive arcade — guide the agent, collect the list. Cold documentary Snake for Lies or Liars.

## Case files

- [The Epstein Files: How the System Protected a Predator](https://liesorliars.com/files/epstein.html): Case File: 001. Federal prosecutors had a 53-page indictment, 30 victims, and overwhelming evidence. They gave him 18 months in county jail with work release.
- [MK Ultra: The CIA's Mind Control Program](https://liesorliars.com/files/mkUltra.html): Case File: 002. For 20 years the CIA experimented on unwitting citizens — prisoners, mental patients, ordinary people. Then they destroyed the evidence. Nobody went to jail.
- [The Iranian Revolution: How Paradise Became Prison](https://liesorliars.com/files/iran.html): Case File: 003. In 1979 millions marched for freedom. They got a theocracy. Forty-seven years later their descendants are still marching for the same things.
- [The Radium Girls: How America Poisoned Its Workers and Called It Progress](https://liesorliars.com/files/radium.html): Case File: 004. The company had internal studies proving radium was lethal. They buried the reports. Over 100 died. No executive was ever charged.
- [The Milk That Killed](https://liesorliars.com/files/nestle.html): Case File: 005. Nestlé knew formula mixed with contaminated water killed infants. They calculated the cost of harm against the cost of profit. They sold it anyway.
- [The Womb Brokers](https://liesorliars.com/files/surrogacy.html): Case File: 006. There is no federal law governing surrogacy agencies in the United States. No licensing. No oversight. No minimum standard of care. Anyone can open one tomorrow.
- [The Brooklyn Rabbi's Kidney Ring](https://liesorliars.com/files/kidney.html): Case File: 007. He told his neighbours he was in construction. For a decade he brokered black market kidney sales — flying donors from Israel, keeping the spread between $10,000 and $160,000.
- [The Ant Hill Kids](https://liesorliars.com/files/anthill.html): Case File: 008. He told them the world was ending in February 1979. He told them he was the only way out. He was wrong about the world. He was right about everything else he could control.
- [The Landlady](https://liesorliars.com/files/landlady.html): Case File: 009. She had a prior conviction for drugging elderly victims. Parole agents visited her boarding house repeatedly. They kept leaving. Seven bodies were in the yard.
- [They Gave Him a Girl's Name. He Spent 30 Years Making Women Pay For It.](https://liesorliars.com/files/cole.html): Case File: 010. At 22 Carroll Cole walked into a police station and told an officer he fantasised about strangling women. A doctor later wrote in his file that he must kill women before he could be intimate with them. Both signed his discharge. Then they opened the door.
- [The Candy Man](https://liesorliars.com/files/candyman.html): Case File: 011. He gave free sweets to the neighbourhood children. He let them use the pool table in the back room of his factory. Between 1970 and 1973 he murdered at least 28 of them. Families reported their sons missing for months. The police called them runaways and closed the files.
- [The Axeman of New Orleans](https://liesorliars.com/files/axeman.html): Case File: 012. In 1919 a serial killer sent a letter to every newspaper in New Orleans. He said he would spare any home playing jazz at midnight on a specific night. The city played until dawn. He kept his word. He was never identified.
- [The Zodiac Killer](https://liesorliars.com/files/zodiac.html): Case File: 013. He sent coded letters to newspapers daring police to break them. One cipher went unsolved for 51 years. He killed at least 5 people across San Francisco in 1968 and 1969. He was never identified. The file is still open.
- [The Gorilla Man: Earle Nelson](https://liesorliars.com/files/nelson.html): Case File: 014. He carried a Bible. He dressed neatly. He knocked on doors and asked for a room. In 18 months he killed 22 boarding house landladies across the United States and Canada. He was caught because he tried to sell a stolen watch for 50 cents.
- [Belle Gunness: The Black Widow of the Prairie](https://liesorliars.com/files/gunness.html): Case File: 015. She placed lonely hearts advertisements in newspapers across America. Widow seeks good man. Must bring funds. The men who answered her ads travelled to a remote Indiana farm. At least 14 were never seen again. When the farmhouse burned down she disappeared too. Nobody knows if she died in the fire or walked away.
- [The UK Government Knew About the Bribes](https://liesorliars.com/files/sangcom.html): Case File: 016. GPT pleaded guilty to corruption on the SANGCOM contracts. Two men were later cleared after the jury heard evidence that Britain had authorised the arrangements.
- [The UK Government Knew The Blood Was Infected](https://liesorliars.com/files/infectedBlood.html): Case File: 017. More than 3000 deaths are attributable to infected NHS blood and blood products. Sir Brian Langstaff found the calamity could largely have been avoided.
